name: default
description: The default Callosium brain: core partitions, note types, routing rules, indexes. Extracted from a year of real multi-agent use.

core.job: the owner's own ventures and side projects, one anchor each; named to never collide with Work/Projects
verbatim source material in topic buckets
generated instructions, schema config, filing rules

serverStamped.rule: stamped by the brain server from the authenticated MCP connection on every agent write; agents cannot forge or omit them; unstamped changes are the human owner's

frontmatter.exempt: verbatim source files keep original content and format untouched

naming.notesAndFolders: plain words with spaces; no number prefixes, underscores, or dashes
naming.dailyMemory: <Source> Daily Memory <DD Mon YYYY> — ONE note per DAY. At the first turn of each day, create THAT day's note; afterwards append only to TODAY's note. Never append to a previous day's note: a dated note stops being written the moment the date changes.

rules: link generously; every note reachable from a hub
long record names link with a piped alias
verify every link target resolves before saving

hubs.pattern: one MOC per major topic; navigation is hub-first, fan out through links
hubs.orphanPolicy: housekeeping flags notes unreachable from any hub

routing.test: authoritative or detail-critical (spec, contract, export, deliverable; exact wording or numbers matter)
routing.action: preserve raw verbatim: work material to Work/Projects/<Name>/Raw/<Doc Type>/, else Reference/<Bucket>/; then a short pointing summary in the matching non-raw location, linked both ways
concise knowledge or memory note in the brain's own words; raw optional
mark clearly; never silently overwrite the owner's words

standingRules.match: credentials, API keys, tokens, passwords or connection strings
standingRules.destination: DO NOT STORE — refuse and tell the owner
standingRules.note: Never write a secret into the brain, even if asked. Say plainly that it belongs in a password manager, and record only the reference: the service name and which account it is for, never the value. Notes are plain files in a folder that is usually synced, and the local version history keeps every past copy of every note — so a key pasted once cannot reliably be un-published afterwards.

groundTruthProtocol: knowledge note ends with a Raw source link
sessionEndRitual: update Goals and Now if priorities shifted; milestone note if a workstream finished
add index lines (Log Index, source Index)

indexes.content: line per record, grouped by month

agentIdentity.registration: each connected AI gets a registered identity at pairing: client type + owner-chosen display name (e.g. 'Claude Desktop', 'OpenClaw (Makoto)')
agentIdentity.attribution: server stamps created_by/updated_by on every MCP write from the authenticated identity
agentIdentity.memorySource: memory records use the agent display name as their Source and file under Memory/<DisplayName>/
agentIdentity.auditLog: append-only server-side log (file, agent, operation, timestamp), rendered as the per-agent audit view in the dashboard

config.note: per-owner settings served over MCP alongside this schema; not part of the schema itself
